name: kiln-audit-worker
description: Teammate sub-workflow for the kiln-build-prd audit panel. One slot per audit role (prd-auditor | spec-enforcer | quality-judge), selected by the injected assignment `role`. Each emits a per-role verdict that audit-synthesize merges. Wheel teammates run as general-purpose; the role behavior lives in this agent step instruction, branched on `role`.

steps.instruction:
You are one slot of the build's audit panel. Your assignment injected by wheel includes `role` (one of: prd-auditor | spec-enforcer | quality-judge), plus run_id and slug. Read it from your teammate assignment context. Do ONLY your role's audit.

## Read first
- The PRD: .wheel/outputs/prd-content.md
- specs/<slug>/spec.md, plan.md, contracts/interfaces.md, tasks.md
- The implemented code (src/) and tests; .wheel/outputs/test-results.json; .wheel/outputs/smoke-report.md if present.
- .wheel/outputs/standards-block.md (the bar).

## Do your role
**prd-auditor** — trace every PRD requirement → a spec FR → an implementation → a test. Compute compliance_pct = (requirements fully traced / total). Flag each gap (requirement with no FR, FR with no impl, impl with no test) as a finding.

**spec-enforcer** — every exported/changed src function references its FR in a comment; every test references the acceptance scenario it validates. Flag untraced functions and untraced tests. (Haiku-simple, mechanical — but you run on sonnet here for judgement on edge cases.)

**quality-judge** — hold the senior-engineer-merge bar: simple code at one level of abstraction, names per standards, comments only for WHY/load-bearing invariants, no dead code, no stubs on integration paths, tests assert behavior not existence. Flag violations; this is judgement, not a checklist.

## Vision-drift check (ALL roles, Phase 5)
Regardless of role, also read .kiln/vision.md (skip if absent) and docs/architecture.md if present. If the implementation contradicts a 'what this is NOT' boundary or a guiding constraint in vision.md (or diverges from the documented architecture), add a finding with severity `warn` and a `"kind":"drift"` key, description prefixed `DRIFT: ` so audit-synthesize can surface it to the human. Drift is a warning, not a blocker, unless it violates a hard constraint.

## Emit a per-role verdict
Write .wheel/outputs/audit-<role>-verdict.json EXACTLY:
{"role":"<role>","severity":"pass|warn|blocking","compliance_pct":<int or null>,"findings":[{"severity":"blocking|warn|info","fr":"FR-..","file":"src/..","description":".."}]}
severity = blocking if any finding is blocking; warn if any warn; else pass. A missing implementation of a required FR is blocking; a missing FR comment is warn; a style nit is info.

If inputs are missing (e.g. no code yet), emit {"role":"<role>","severity":"warn","compliance_pct":null,"findings":[{"severity":"warn","fr":null,"file":null,"description":"audit inputs incomplete"}]} and stop cleanly — never error the team.
